📌 Tehran, IRNA — Judiciary Chief Gholamhossein Mohseni Eje’i has described the Aerospace Force unit of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) as one of the pillars of Iran’s deterrence power.

In a message on Monday, marking Aerospace Week, Mohseni Eje’i defined the occasion as a commemoration of the epic achievements made by Iranian youth and scientific elites over the years.
​
Pointing to Iran’s extraordinary accomplishment in scientific and technological arenas, based on domestic know-how, he said the people, through faith, knowledge, and an unshakeable, impenetrable resolve, could successfully elevate Iran to the pinnacle of authority.
​
The judiciary chief, in particular, underscored the success stories of the country’s aerospace sector, noting that the IRGC Aerospace Force — leveraging indigenous capabilities and the knowledge of Iranian experts — has become a cornerstone of Iran’s deterrence strength.
​
The pride-inspiring operations of heroic Aerospace Force units thwarted the calculations of the American-Israeli enemy, especially during the 12-day and 40-day wars, leaving them desperate in the face of Iran’s resolve and defensive capabilities, Mohseni Eje’i emphasized.
​
Referring to a wide range of indigenously produced military equipment, he said the authority of the Aerospace division today is the outcome of the dedicated efforts of a generation that transformed self-belief into power, knowledge into technology, and threats into opportunities.
​
Mohseni Eje’i concluded his message, paying gratitude to the martyrs, including Hassan Tehrani Moghaddam, Amir-Ali Hajizadeh, and all other proud martyrs, who played a critical role in the development of the Aerospace sector.
